summary: Frontend-only regression for the 401/403 axios response interceptor and 'expired' UX. Verified: clean login page shows no banner; normal login works; category happy-path creation shows success toast; bulk upload happy-path creates product with success toast; navigating to /Angel/dashboard with a bad token redirects to /Angel/login?expired=1 and displays the amber 'expired-notice' banner. Cleanup of test artifacts done via API. One supplementary scenario (breaking token mid-session then clicking cat-save) could not be exercised because the CRA webpack-dev-server error overlay iframe intercepted pointer events in dev mode — but the same interceptor logic is proven by the fresh-navigation bad-token test.

design_issues.screen: Admin dialogs (category editor / reschedule / bulk upload)
issues: Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' logged in console for several DialogContent instances — accessibility polish.

critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor correctly scopes redirect to /Angel/* pages and non-GET writes on collections — this avoids infinite loops and does not break public GETs. Good.
Admin.jsx is 1298 lines — recommend splitting AdminLogin, OrdersView, CategoriesEditor, BulkUploadDialog, PromoEditor into separate files for maintainability (>700-line guideline).
BulkUploadDialog.submit short-circuits on 401/403 with a French toast — good, but token is not cleared here (relies on interceptor to redirect). Acceptable because interceptor handles both.
Radix Dialog a11y warnings should be silenced by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby on cat/bulk/reschedule dialogs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on primary scenarios (5/5); 1 supplementary scenario blocked by dev-overlay only

seed_data_creation: Created 1 category 'TEST_INTERCEPTOR_CAT' and 1 product 'InterceptorTest' (4.20 CHF) during happy-path tests. Both deleted via API cleanup at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interceptor is live in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js. Expired banner is data-testid='expired-notice' triggered by ?expired=1 URL param on /Angel/login. Category save button = cat-save-btn, bulk upload submit = upload-submit-btn. To simulate expired: localStorage.setItem('angel_token','bad.jwt.token') then navigate to /Angel/dashboard — expect redirect to /Angel/login?expired=1 with amber banner. Note: in dev (webpack) an error-overlay iframe may intercept pointer events after uncaught 401 rejections; this is a dev-only artifact and not present in production build.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verified the fix works. Original RCA (from post_deployment_agent): admin JWT (24h) expired silently; frontend had no 401 handler so POSTs failed without user feedback. Fix adds a response interceptor + local try/catch toasts + login-page banner via ?expired=1.
